historical_references.reference: Arteshtar was a Persian vizier who served under the Buyid dynasty (932-1062 AD). He is most famous for his role in the Isfahan revolt against the Buyids, during which he successfully led the rebels to overthrow the Buyid governor and establish an independent state.
historical_references.context: Isfahan revolt against the Buyid dynasty

historical_references.reference: Arteshtar was also a notable Persian poet and scholar during the Ilkhanate period (1256-1353 AD). He is known for his contributions to the fields of mathematics, astronomy, and philosophy, particularly his work on the geometry of regular solids and the translation of Aristotle's works into Persian.
